chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from one of his companions, from Abu Hafs al-Abbar, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
‘It is upon you with the lettuce, for it cleans the blood’.
ai.seo_question: What is the health benefit of eating lettuce according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) recommends lettuce (*al-khas*) for its blood-purifying properties, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating practical medicine (*tibb*) with spiritual guidance. This advice underscores the holistic view of the body as an amanah, where dietary choices directly influence physical and spiritual well-being, a concept deeply rooted in the Prophetic and Imami medical traditions.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from one of his companions, from Abu Hafs Al Abbar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘it is upon you with (eating) the lettuce, for it cleans the blood’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘ Abd Allah from his father from certain persons of his people from abu Hafs ibn al-Abbar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must eat lettuce because it cleanses blood.’”
